{{Top|leg}}
The '''keeper of memories''' was a title given to an individual who recorded the history of the [[Promised Ones]], who were the only survivors of the [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire's]] [[Destruction of Taris|bombardment]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The keepers included [[Rukil]], [[Baral]], [[Ku-ki|Ku Ki]], and [[Lurr (individual)|Lurr]].
